name: snowflake
description: Open a link through the Tor·Snowflake transport (NP11/NP12 of docs/2026-10-15-clear-glass-network-posture-phasemap.spec). Right-click a link → 'Open link with Snowflake' opens it in a new window whose session is forced through the transport and fails closed. The routing, policy table and transport process stay in Clear Glass's core (src/net); this plugin is the surface: disable it and the menu row goes away, and nothing is ever routed direct as a result. Its page (click it in the 🧩 panel) imports host lists — a file or a folder — as sites that always go through Snowflake, adds one site, and removes a list; the rules are core's, and a site already routed another way is left as it was.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
